analysis.mode: PSNR (pair0 sigma=1.11 < 2; candidate pipeline contains no noise_* function, so PSNR criterion applies)
analysis.support_validation: control compression_jpeg:1 reproduces all 5 support pairs bit-exactly: pair0/1/2/3/4 PSNR=inf dB, CI 10/10 each. Boundary-signal alternatives are strictly worse: H2 noise_gaussian_YCrCb:2->jpeg:1 on pair1 verify_signals WEAK-side PARTIAL with noise:sigma diff=200%; H3 contrast_weaken_scale:1->jpeg:1 on pair3 PSNR=22.26 dB; H4 blur_gaussian:1->jpeg:1 on pair2 PSNR=34.20 dB.
analysis.rationale: R1 re-ran full analysis on all 5 pairs. pair-level signals are consistent with a single deterministic JPEG step (block_boundary 1.21-1.74 > 1.1 on all pairs; spectral_slope_ratio 0.997-1.002 excludes blur; variance_ratio 0.944-0.999 / mean_shift <=0.6/255 excludes global). The threshold-boundary signals that could have suggested missed steps were reinterpreted and falsified: (a) noise_prior sigma 2.22/4.32 on pairs 1/3 crosses the sigma>=2 mode switch, but peeling jpeg:1 leaves an exactly-zero residual (std=0.0, bit-exact) -> sigma is a JPEG-artifact false positive, NO_NOISE; (b) gm_ratio<0.85 on pairs 1/2/4 is JPEG-artifact driven (spectral slope unchanged) and adding blur drops PSNR to 34.20 dB; (c) pair3 variance_ratio=0.9437/heavy clipping is clean-content + JPEG smoothing, adding contrast drops PSNR to 22.26 dB. A bit-exact reproduction of 5 different contents cannot coexist with any additional non-identity step. Nothing can exceed PSNR=inf, so pipeline stays identical to R0.

signal_sources: unique_G target = 256/256/256/256/252, dct_zero_ratio = 0.7528/0.7581/0.8731/0.4815/0.8446 -> compression present, JPEG subtype; severity pinned to 1 (quality 25) by bit-exact reproduction (jpeg:2 gives 29.07 dB on pair0)
variance_ratio = 0.9888 / 0.9897 / 0.9932 / 0.9437 / 0.9993; mean_shift = 0.1/0.2/0.1/0.6/0.0 (of 255); clipped_fraction <= 0.0662 -> no contrast/brightness step

noise_prior sigma = 1.11 / 2.22 / 0.37 / 4.32 / 0.62 is content-dependent and JPEG-artifact driven: peeled residual after compression_jpeg:1 is exactly 0.0 (std=0.0) on pairs 1 and 3 (sigma-boundary pairs) -> NO_NOISE
